risk_summary: A CI deployment identity uses short-lived workload identity federation, scoped permissions, named ownership, review cadence, and deprovisioning hooks.

identity.name: ci-deploy-prod-api
identity.purpose: deploy signed production API releases from protected main branch

audit_and_deprovisioning: credential subject is logged on every token exchange
owner transfer is required before team deactivation
unused identity alert fires after 30 days

expected_assessment.review_note: The flow is a safe comparator because authority is short-lived, scoped to a protected workload boundary, owned by an active team, and observable through deployment provenance.
